## 2026-11-03: live fsck with the overlap rule — 0 issues

Read-only `rebar store fsck --dry-run` against the live tracker (`/Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.tickets-tracker`, current env 492a5c71), run from worktree `fix-esok-overlap`.

**Before** (origin/main `f1fe7c6f587`, 09:12 PST): one counted issue.
```
ENV_ID_MISMATCH: this environment ('492a5c71-6cda-48a6-8134-02ff6a672739') has also written events under 2 other environment id(s) (ade0f2ef-51cc-45a2-bb97-c09846cd3df5, b8a354e0-12c3-4cf2-bbf1-fcc9685d5126) — the same author(s) appear under both. ...
fsck complete: 1 issues found      (exit 1)
```

**After** (commit `b6c09c0bfad`-lineage, Gerrit change 3270 patch set 1, 09:29 PST): no `ENV_ID_MISMATCH` line (grep count 0). Tail:
```
ensures: 10/10 applied
authorship: 60117 signed, 20254 unsigned event(s) — run `rebar verify-identity`
fsck complete: no issues found      (exit 0)
```
No `UNSIGNED_ENV`, `FOREIGN_STORE_PATH`, `MISSING_CREATE`, `ORPHAN_EVENT` or `SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT` lines in either run. Lines that remain are informational and not counted (`UNCERTIFIED_CLOSE`, `STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED`).

**Overlap rule.** Closed intervals: per author, the spans `(first, last)` under two env ids overlap when `a1 <= b2 and a2 <= b1`. A shared boundary timestamp counts as overlap, and a span with no integer timestamp counts as overlapping. On this store's Aug 9 handover, RebarBotNava's last event under ade0f2ef (19:51:58.58 PDT) and first under b8a354e0 (20:44:59.12 PDT) are 53 minutes apart, so the rule classifies them as sequential. A test pins those exact timestamps.

**Stated limit.** Event timestamps are HLC values (`hlc.next_tick` = max(cache, ticket witness, wall clock)+1). They are never earlier than the writer's wall clock but can run later. Cross-host clock skew larger than the gap between two clones can therefore misclassify them in either direction. This is documented in `_overlaps`.

Discovered and filed: westbound-chivalric-pinemarten. The ENV_ID_MISMATCH line and the mint warning both still say re-clone attestations stop verifying, which has been false by default since `3bde5613718` (bug `c21f-6f29-5d2d-4a5a`).
